skills.skill: Determine the greatest common factor of two whole numbers
Determine the lowest common multiple of two whole numbers

misconceptions.pattern: Reports the lowest common multiple when asked for the greatest common factor (answers GCF of 4 and 6 as 12 instead of 2), swapping the two ideas.
Reports the greatest common factor when asked for the lowest common multiple (answers LCM of 4 and 6 as 2 instead of 12), swapping the two ideas.

strategies.intent: A factor divides into the number (so the GCF is no larger than the smaller number); a multiple is the number counted up (so the LCM is at least the larger number). List factors for GCF and count up in multiples for LCM.
